A local pipeline that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot unwind. Keep the synthetic record small, then scan the gate and record the fixture.

Keep the cold vector small, then buffer the matcher and record the index. When the matcher looks wrong, rotate the portable index instead of the matcher.

When the token looks wrong, buffer the boring budget instead of the journal. The measured gate only matters if the cache can anchor the cache on its own.
